title: PoweredBy and utmz
body:
To be able to easily track where the users are coming from when clicking PoweredBy link, we should:
- default poweredBy link should go to: https://www.algolia.com/?utm_source=instantsearch.js&utm_medium=website&utm_content=$location.hostname&utm_campaign=poweredby (where $location.hostname is the current domain name)
- provide an option to configure the powered by link to go anywhere we want (configure the full href)
